extracted_factors.Label: Improper Permit Granting
extracted_factors.Description: The study highlights improper permit granting as a primary cause of deforestation, regulatory violations, and mining infringements in East Kalimantan.

extracted_factors.Label: Deforestation due to Coal Mining
extracted_factors.Description: Deforestation is a consequence of coal mining expansion, causing significant loss of forests in East Kalimantan.

extracted_factors.Label: Human Safety Hazards
extracted_factors.Description: The presence of water-filled mining pits poses drowning hazards, notably affecting children and adjacent communities.

extracted_factors.Label: Regulatory Infringements
extracted_factors.Description: The mining activities often violate regulatory boundaries, posing environmental and social risks.

extracted_factors.Label: Lacking Reclamation
extracted_factors.Description: Insufficient backfilling and reclamation of inactive mine pits increase environmental degradation and safety risks.

extracted_factors.Label: Social Inequality
extracted_factors.Description: The economic benefits of resource extraction have sharpened social inequality in East Kalimantan.
